niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one single “best” CTV advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, geography, measurement needs and whether you want programmatic or direct buys.

To help you pick, consider these criteria first:
- Campaign objective: branding vs direct response/performance
- Inventory type: premium publisher/streaming apps (Hulu, Paramount+, Peacock) vs programmatic exchanges
- Targeting needs: household-level, cross‑device, audience segments, geo
- Measurement & attribution: Nielsen, comScore, MRC metrics, or custom outcome tracking
- Creative capabilities: dynamic creative, versioning, interactive/companion assets
- Transparency & reporting cadence
- Budget and contract flexibility
- Existing platform partnerships (Roku, Samsung Ads, Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, Magnite, Tremor, etc.)

Agency categories and who to consider by use case
- Big global/full‑service (best for large national/global brands, cross‑media planning): GroupM (Mindshare/MediaCom), Omnicom (OMD/Hearts & Science), Publicis (Starcom/Spark Foundry), Dentsu (Carat) and IPG (UM/Initiative).
- Programmatic/performance specialists (strong DSP relationships and optimization): agencies that work deeply with The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, Magnite or Amobee; many independent digital/media shops focus solely on programmatic CTV.
- Creative & measurement specialists (if you need advanced creative personalization and verified exposure): partners like Innovid, VideoAmp, and ad verification vendors (DoubleVerify, IAS) often work alongside agencies.
- Platform/direct buys (if you want guaranteed premium placements): work directly with platform teams (Roku OneView/Roku Ad Studio, Samsung Ads, Vizio, Xumo, Tubi) or an agency with established direct publisher relationships.
- Small/local budgets: boutique CTV agencies or performance media shops that specialize in testing and smaller buys.

What to ask any prospective CTV agency
- Case studies and KPIs for campaigns similar to yours
- Which streaming platforms and SSP/DSP partners they work with
- Measurement partners and how they report viewability, completion, and reach
- Creative capabilities and ad formats supported
- Fee structure and transparency on media vs tech fees
- Sample flight plan and optimization cadence
- References from clients in your vertical

If you want, tell me:
- Your budget range
- Target geography and audience
- Primary goal (brand awareness, lower-funnel conversions, app installs, etc.)
- Whether you prefer programmatic or publisher-direct buys

I’ll recommend a tailored shortlist of agencies and platforms that fit your needs.
